bibliographic.title: Recurrent
bibliographic.author: Matchstick IF
bibliographic.description:
You’ve completed your mission. Your only remaining task is to make it home alive. How hard could that be?

Turns out, it’s a lot harder than you think.

--

Recurrent was written for the 2024 Single Choice Jam, and you have one choice: Jump. Mind your timing, the obstacles are deadly and plentiful.
